name: Translate to Vietnamese
description: A voice speaks what you say in Vietnamese. Needs speech recognition and AI voices. Downloads a 131 MB translation model and voice once, when you ask for it; translating then happens on this PC.
credits: English to Vietnamese model from the Argos Translate package index: OPUS-MT (Tiedemann & Thottingal, 2020), CC BY 4.0. Voice: Piper voice vi_VN-vais1000-medium from rhasspy/piper-voices, CC BY 4.0.
